subject: Request: short-notice sandbox boost for POC load window
messages:
From: Laura Simmons <laura@elevate.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: partner_ops@aws-marketplace.com
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — extra sandbox headroom for scheduled POC load run

Hi Vivek,

We're scheduled to run our scaled throughput sweep for the Redwood POC the week of Jul 5 — the customer wants a condensed 36-hour window where we'll push close to peak concurrency to validate end-to-end latencies. Our infra folks ran a preliminary sim and estimate ~220k tokens per hour at the test configuration, so we'll need a temporary token buffer to avoid throttling mid-run.

Can Redwood provide a short-term sandbox boost or promo allocation for that window? Ideally: 800k tokens/day for three days (Jul 5–7). If you prefer a burst quota with auto-throttle fallback, we can accept that as well. I've attached the load plan and a topology diagram.

This is critical for the customer's go/no-go next week and part of the final acceptance criteria in our contract. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the plan.

Thanks,
Laura Simmons
Head of Integrations, Elevate.ai
[Attachment: elevate_load_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: elevate-poc-diagram.png (image/png)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Simmons <laura@elevate.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — extra sandbox headroom for scheduled POC load run

Folks — forwarding Elevate's ask. They need a short-term token buffer for a concentrated load verification early July. Details in the attachments.

Marissa — can you confirm account health (usage to date) and whether a promotional uplift is okay under the current trial terms? If a credit grant is needed, Priyom can advise on promo band and sign-off. If helpful, I can approve an emergency burst up to 300k tokens/hour for a 72-hour window, pending finance sign-off.

Laura — looping in our account lead and finance. We'll aim to get you an answer by Monday EOD.

- Vivek
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Simmons <laura@elevate.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — extra sandbox headroom for scheduled POC load run

Thanks for the ping. Quick notes after reviewing their hubspot record and the attached plan: they've used ~12% of their trial footprint so far and their config matches the performance profile we expect. Given this is a customer-facing acceptance test tied to an enterprise proof, I'm comfortable recommending a temporary promotional uplift rather than a paid top-up.

Suggested grant: 900k tokens/day for Jul 5–7 (3 days), with an automatic throttle threshold at 1.25M tokens/day and an alert to the account team at 80% consumption. We'll require that they use the provided test endpoints (no production routing) and sign a brief agreement that makes the allocation one-time and non-transferable.

Priyom — can you confirm the promo band and route for doing this as a 'trial extension credit' (no invoice) and record it against DEAL-7051? If acceptable, I'll queue the uplift and notify Elevate.

Marissa
Account Manager — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Laura Simmons <laura@elevate.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — extra sandbox headroom for scheduled POC load run

Acknowledged. Finance confirms we can issue a non-billable promo allocation under our promotional credit policy for customer acceptance tests, limited to one-time grants per deal. Approvals: Marissa (AM) + Director sign-off (Vivek) are sufficient for up to $12k equivalent value. Please note: this will create a HubSpot credit record and a short audit note.

I'll prepare the internal voucher and route the quote id to Marissa for the uplift action. Proposed parameters: 900k tokens/day for Jul 5–7 (3 days). We'll attach an audit note and the signed scope-of-use agreement to the HubSpot record.

Priyom
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: promo-voucher-D7051.pdf (stub: generated voucher)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simmons <laura@elevate.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: temporary sandbox uplift for Elevate POC (Jul 5–7)

Laura — quick update and confirmation.

We've approved a one-time promotional uplift for Elevate (DEAL-7051): 900k tokens/day for the 72-hour window Jul 5 00:00 UTC — Jul 7 23:59 UTC. Guardrails in place:
- Auto-throttle at 1.25M tokens/day to prevent runaway spend.
- Real-time usage alerts at 80% and 95% thresholds to me and Marissa.
- Allocation applies only to the designated sandbox endpoints in your load plan; production endpoints will remain at standard trial quotas.
- Please return signed scope-of-use (I included a pointer to the DocuSign link) prior to the run.

Priyom has created the internal voucher and logged it against the HubSpot record. Marissa will push the allocation Tuesday AM and confirm when it's live.

Good luck with the sweep — loop me in if anything spikes unexpectedly.

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
